name: Sparrow Mahjong Club
description: Charlotte-based American Mahjong club offering weekly open play, beginner and advanced lessons, special events and tournaments.
schedule: Weekly Open Play Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday evenings at venues in South Charlotte; membership is $45/month, with non-member event tickets also offered.

name: Charlotte Mahjong
description: Charlotte-area American Mahjong community offering lessons, monthly social/open-play events, private lessons and hosted events.
schedule: Monthly social events plus scheduled MAHJ 101/Part II lessons; private lessons and events available by booking.

name: Queen City Mahjong
description: American Mahjong instruction and assisted open play serving Charlotte; founded by Jill Graham and additional instructors.
schedule: Group lessons at the Junior League of Charlotte; assisted open play Wednesdays 6:00-8:00 PM at Gourmand Market at APEX across from SouthPark Mall; private socials also available.

name: Crown & Tile
description: American Mahjong lessons, guided open play and private events based in Belmont and serving the greater Charlotte area.
schedule: Scheduled 2-hour lessons and open play at Jekyll and Hyde Taphouse Grill in Belmont; Oct. 13 lesson and November/December open-play dates are posted.
